name: Cross animation
summary: Red circle that draws in, then an X draws inside it with a little shake; for wrong answers and fails.

params.name: s
params.note: scale; circle is 300 px across at s = 1

params.name: at
params.note: start as a fraction of the shot (0..1)

params.name: atFrame
params.note: start frame inside the shot; overrides at
